parsed.post: My last attempt at increasing LR with DEPTH=8 failed (1.0966 vs 1.0357). The higher capacity model seems sensitive to high learning rates. I am reverting to my best commit (9b5e464) and will instead focus on reducing the batch size to increase optimizer steps, which often helps deeper models converge better within a fixed time budget.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget for the DEPTH=8 model.
